items.title: Arrive Haneda (HND) T2 (possibly T3)
items.how: Haneda Airport T2, international area. ANA shows the expected arrival terminal on its flight-status page 2 days before and confirms it 2 h before landing
items.notes: Immigration, baggage and customs (fill in Visit Japan Web first for the QR codes). Add Suica to your phone wallet before flying, so there is no card queue

items.title: Transit · Haneda → Shinjuku → Matsumoto (Ltd Exp Azusa 9)
items.how:
Airport Limousine bus T2 → Shinjuku Sta West Exit (Keiō Dept Store), ¥1,400 pp, 07:45 → 08:20 timetabled (allow 60–70 min on a Monday morning). The bus starts at T3 and calls at T2 10 min later
Ltd Exp Azusa 9: Shinjuku 09:00 → Matsumoto 11:39 (reserved seats, ~¥6,700 pp)
items.notes:
05:55 Land at T2
06:00–07:00 Immigration, bags, customs
07:00–07:35 Seven Bank ATM for ¥ (T2 2F Welcome Center, 06:00–23:00), toilets; then down to 1F for bus tickets (Limousine ticket machines / counter) and the bus stop outside
07:45 Bus from T2 (take the 07:25 if out early); bags go under the bus
08:20 Shinjuku West Exit (timetabled; ~08:35 in Monday traffic); 5–10 min walk to the JR gates
08:40 Print the Azusa tickets at a reserved-seat machine (QR from the booking); drinks or an ekiben
08:50 On the platform
09:00 Depart
11:39 Matsumoto; 5 min walk to Dormy Inn
Out by ~06:45: 06:55 bus, switch to Azusa 5 (08:00 → 10:37). Out after 07:45: 08:15 bus, switch to Azusa 13 (10:00 → 12:37). One free change at the machine
If you land at T3 instead: same buses 10 min earlier (06:45 / 07:15 / 07:35 / 08:05); Seven Bank ATM and Limousine counter are in the T3 arrivals hall, 2F; the Azusa 9 plan holds
Rail alt (~¥540 pp): Keikyū from Haneda T1·T2 Sta → Shinagawa → JR Yamanote Line → Shinjuku, ~45 min, but Monday rush hour with suitcases
Taxi alt: fixed fare ~¥9,000 + tolls per car to Shinjuku
items.action: ★ Reserve Azusa 9 seats on eki-net (opens 9 Oct, 10:00 JST)

items.title: Drop bags · Dormy Inn Matsumoto (1 nt)

5 min walk from JR Matsumoto Sta
MC 75 821 318*64
items.notes: Drop bags on arrival; check in properly later. Natural onsen; breakfast incl.; 2 rooms
items.action: Future payment 6 Nov (S$)

items.title: Lunch · Sobakiri Miyota (toji-soba)
items.how: Gokō Honmachi Bldg 1F, 2-1-24 Chūō, Matsumoto; 5 min walk from the station and Dormy Inn
items.notes: Tabelog 3.49; Matsumoto's toji-soba (soba dipped shabu-style in hot sansai broth). Kitchen L.O. 14:30 sharp and it can sell out, so go straight from the station if the train runs late. Closed Thu. Backup: Kurekino, station bldg 1F (all-day soba, Tabelog 3.49)

items.title: Former Kaichi School (旧開智学校), National Treasure
items.how:
2-4-12 Kaichi, Matsumoto 〒390-0876
~20–25 min walk from Dormy Inn via Nawate-dōri (or Town Sneaker North bus)
items.notes: Reopened Nov 2024 after a 3-year seismic retrofit. 09:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30), ¥700. Open Mon 9 Nov (Mar–Nov it closes only on the 3rd Tue). Alt: Ishii Miso free brewery tour (English tour 13:30)

items.title: Stroll · Nawate-dōri ('Frog Street') and Nakamachi
items.how:
Nawate-dōri (Ōte 4-chōme) ↔ Nakamachi; ~10 min walk from Dormy Inn
MC 75 821 687*34
items.notes: Antique stalls, cafés, kura storehouses; flat and walkable. Café: Coffee Bigaku Abe, 1-2-8 Fukashi (Tabelog 3.64; 1957 jun-kissa, mocha parfait; until ~16:30). The famous Marumo is closed Mon. All-day alt: Kamenoya beside Nawate-dōri (until 20:00, no closing day)

items.title: Dinner · Matsumoto Karaage Center; then hotel onsen
items.how: MIDORI Matsumoto 4F, 1-1-1 Fukashi (station bldg, 2 min from Dormy Inn)
items.notes: Sanzoku-yaki (garlic-soy fried chicken), national karaage-award winner, Tabelog 3.46, teishoku. ⚠ L.O. 19:30, so sit down by 19:00. Backup: Katsugen tonkatsu honten (Tabelog 3.43, 4-9-7 Ōte, L.O. 20:00). Hotel onsen open late

days.sub: Train and bus up to Kamikochi

items.title: Check out · Dormy Inn Matsumoto; forward suitcases
items.how: Matsumoto
items.notes: Forward the big suitcases to Chateraise Hotel Nagano for 13 Nov (Yamato TA-Q-BIN from the Dormy front desk, ~¥2–3k per bag, unverified); carry day packs for 3 nights (Kamikochi 2, Ōgatō 1). Buy lunch to carry (Ekiben Azusa bento inside the JR gates, or a station-bldg bakery): Kamikochi eateries thin out in closing week

items.title: Walk · Taishō Pond → Kappa Bridge → Myōjin Pond
items.how:
Kamikochi valley, flat wooden boardwalks
Start: any down bus Kamikochi Bus Terminal → Taishō-ike stop (~10 min), or walk the extra hour
items.notes: Taishō Pond → Kappa Bridge ~1 h; Kappa Bridge → Myōjin Pond and back via the opposite bank ~2 h. ~3 h of walking, no elevation gain; Mt Hotaka reflected in the water. No need to go as far as Tokusawa. (Taishō-ike bus hop: frequency in closing week unverified)

items.title: Shuttle · Matsumoto Sta → Ōgatō Hotel
items.how:
Ōgatō Hotel free shuttle from Matsumoto Sta Castle Exit (お城口): turn left toward the 7-Eleven and wait at the temporary tourist-bus parking area (観光バス臨時駐車場)
Dep 13:45 → hotel ~15:20
items.notes:
13:25 At the waiting area; the bus will not wait for latecomers
13:45 Depart (~1 h 35; may run late in bad weather)
~15:20 Ōgatō Hotel
Runs year-round. Summer timetable 22 Apr–17 Nov (13:45 up, 11:15 down); winter timetable from 18 Nov has other times. Both your legs fall in the summer timetable
items.action: ★ Reserve both shuttle legs by 9 Nov (≥3 days before the stay); limited seats, first-come

items.how:

MC 1004 037 444*20 · alt 1004 009 327*58 (Okusha gate car park, ¥600 / 3 h)
items.notes: Zuishinmon gate is ~15 min on a gentle path; the Okusha is another ~20–25 min beyond it, steep at the end. Turning back at the gate saves ~45 min. Okusha and Kuzuryūsha close ~late Nov; snow tyres needed above ~1,200 m

items.title: Naena Falls (Naena-no-taki), if open
items.how:
Drive via Shinano-machi IC → Jōshin'etsu Expwy → Myōkō-Kōgen IC, ~65 min (est.)
Naena Falls car park, Suginozawa, Myōkō, Niigata; 500 m / 15 min walk (~100 free spaces)
MC 469 046 579*87
items.notes: 55 m falls, one of Japan's Top 100 Waterfalls. Trail closes for winter ~early–mid Nov (snow); if gated, go straight to Nou (arrive ~13:00)
items.action: ★ Call Myōkō-Kōgen tourism ☎ 0255-86-3911 (~11 Nov) to check the trail

items.title: Late lunch · Kaniya Yokochō crab stalls, Marine Dream Nou
items.how:

Michi-no-Eki Marine Dream Nou, 3596-2 Nou-Kodomari, Itoigawa 〒949-1351 (☎ 025-566-3456)
MC 707 090 264*60
items.notes: Pick a boiled benizuwai (~¥1–3k per crab, about 1 pp) from the 7 fishing-family stalls; try Hōjumaru (known to add a free bonus crab). They crack it and you eat at the free tables. Stalls close 17:00 from Nov and sell out. Sit-down alt inside: Banya (crab-tempura teishoku ~¥2.6k)
